source_summary: Vertical ink-and-light-wash Chinese mountain landscape dominated by misty cliffs, dotted vegetation, bamboo-like groves, a large gnarled foreground pine group, rocky ledges, and a small stream at the base. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: distant_misty_peaks
motifs.description: Faint upper-right mountain silhouettes and high ridge outlines, including pale ink contour lines, soft gray wash, atmospheric gaps, and the sparse dark dots on the right slope; isolate only the distant peak forms and mist edges, excluding calligraphy and seals.
must_preserve: small dark vegetation dots on right slope

motifs.name: right_shrubbed_cliff_face
motifs.description: Tall right-side cliff mass descending from the upper mountains, with layered rock planes, streaked washes, clustered ink-dot shrubs, and jagged contour accents; isolate the cliff texture and vegetation from the foreground pine branches crossing nearby.
must_preserve: soft misty breaks between rock planes

motifs.name: left_misty_gorge_cliff
motifs.description: Pale left-side gorge wall and narrow ravine-like mountain form, with washed vertical cliff edges, sparse dotted foliage, and faint descending rock planes; exclude the central pine trunk and calligraphy area.

motifs.name: gnarled_foreground_pines
motifs.description: Large foreground pine group with twisting trunks, exposed knots, broken angular branches, and dense needle clusters spanning the center of the painting; isolate all visible pine trunks, limbs, bark dots, and needle sprays while leaving background cliffs behind.
must_preserve: dark bark stippling along trunk edges
irregular knots and broken limb tips
contrast between dark ink strokes and pale trunk wash

motifs.name: right_slender_bamboo_grove
motifs.description: Narrow grove of thin vertical bamboo or reed-like stalks on the right middle slope, with fine parallel stems, small leafy marks, and pale wash behind them; isolate the grove only, not the adjacent pine branch or cliff.

motifs.name: left_lower_bamboo_grove
motifs.description: Lower-left grove of slender bamboo or reeds rising beside the rock slope, including clustered vertical stems, sparse leafy tops, and darker dotted foliage at the base; exclude the surrounding rock ledge except where stems touch it.
must_preserve: small leaf clusters and twig marks
dense dark dots near the base

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_ledge
motifs.description: Broad angular foreground rock terrace beneath the pines, with faceted stone planes, dark ink outlines, dry-brush striations, pale gray washes, and small shrub dots along crevices; isolate the ledge and attached root area, not the pine foliage above.
must_preserve: small dotted shrubs and moss marks
root-like lines where pine meets rock

motifs.name: bottom_stream_rocks_shrubs
motifs.description: Bottom-left stream margin with curved water lines, small rounded rocks, and low dark shrub clusters at the base of the composition; isolate the water-edge curves, stones, and nearby vegetation without including seals or paper texture.
must_preserve: soft gray wash around water edge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
